card.name: Comma right after anthrax
card.fires_on: The comma directly after the word anthrax in a list of infections or threats. It also fires weakly on nearby words in anthrax-related text (contract, cause, raxibacumab).

modes.label: Comma after anthrax
modes.description: A comma following anthrax inside a list of severe infections or threats.

modes.label: Other anthrax-context words
modes.description: Words in anthrax passages that come just before or inside the word anthrax or an anthrax drug name.
modes.example: People who<< contract>> anthrax produce antibodies to protective antigen protein

card.writes: Weakly promotes odd word starts such as Anth, tear and wild, and suppresses O-initial pieces; the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the comma after "anthrax" in lists of serious infections.
